title: Writing: A Travel Essay — "What Travel Taught Me"

writingModel.placeholder: Begin with a specific moment or image — where were you, what happened?
writingModel.hint: Start in medias res — a moment, not a general statement

writingModel.placeholder: Describe what surprised or challenged you about the culture or place
writingModel.hint: Be specific — use prepositions carefully (in, at, on, through, across)

writingModel.placeholder: Reflect on what this taught you about yourself or your own culture
writingModel.hint: Use: "I became aware of…", "I realised that…", "I was proud of… but surprised by…"

writingModel.placeholder: End with what you bring back — how travel changed you
writingModel.hint: Use strong, specific language — not "it was amazing"

writingTemplate.placeholder: Opening moment: where you were and what was happening (specific, concrete)
writingTemplate.hint: Use past continuous + past simple for scene-setting

writingTemplate.placeholder: a specific cultural difference or encounter
writingTemplate.hint: Be precise — a sound, a sight, a conversation, a custom

writingTemplate.placeholder: your initial reaction — uncomfortable / confused / fascinated
writingTemplate.hint: Honest reactions make better writing than idealising

writingTemplate.prefix: In time, I came to realise that
writingTemplate.placeholder: what you understood about the difference — and about yourself
writingTemplate.hint: "In time" = after a while; use "came to + infinitive"

writingTemplate.suffix: by what that experience taught me.
writingTemplate.hint: "Looking back" for reflection; use past participle after "am"

writingTemplate.placeholder: a new perspective / a deeper awareness of my own assumptions
writingTemplate.hint: End with something abstract but meaningful

items: I was walking along the river when…
At the airport in Seoul, I noticed that…
On a train travelling through the mountains…
In the market, surrounded by unfamiliar sounds and smells…
By the time I arrived at the border, I already felt…
What surprised me most was the attitude towards…
I was unfamiliar with the custom of…
At first, I was uncomfortable with the idea of…
In time, I became accustomed to…
I came to appreciate the way in which…
Looking back, I realise that…
The experience made me aware of my own assumptions about…
I returned home with a deeper respect for…
Travel taught me that…
I was proud of my own culture, but also curious about…
On arrival in the city, I was struck by…
By the end of the week, I had become accustomed to…
In contrast to what I expected, the people were…
Compared to my own experience, the approach to time was…
As a result of the trip, I am now more interested in…

questions.text: "She arrived ___ the city ___ a hot afternoon ___ July."
questions.hint: "In the city" (enclosed space); "on a hot afternoon"; "in July"

questions.text: "___ arrival ___ the hotel, guests are asked to check in ___ the reception desk."
questions.hint: "On arrival"; "at the hotel"; "at the reception desk"

questions.text: "She is very sensitive ___ cultural norms and responsible ___ training the team."
"The reason ___ misunderstanding is often a lack ___ cultural awareness."
"We set off ___ dawn and walked ___ the forest, arriving ___ the summit by noon."
"He is interested about Korean culture" is grammatically correct.
"Travelling ___ different cultures results ___ greater empathy and understanding."
questions.hint: "Travel through" different cultures; "result in" = lead to

questions.text: "___ the end of the trip, she had changed — she was more open ___ new ideas."
questions.hint: "By the end" = deadline/completion point; "open to" new ideas
